description: Convert L-BTC to USDC/USDT delivered to an external EVM or Tron address via a Boltz chain swap (NON-custodial on the Liquid side; the L-BTC lockup is refundable). MOVES MONEY: the L-BTC lockup passes through the owner's guardrails (value caps; the destination claim_address is checked against the allowlist when it is enabled) BEFORE signing. The EVM legs run in the background after funding. amount_sats is L-BTC base units.

amount_sats.description: Amount in the asset's BASE UNITS (sats), as a decimal integer STRING. 1 DePix cent = 1,000,000 sats. Never pass a BRL value here.

asset.description: Which stablecoin to receive: USDC or USDT.

claim_address.description: FINAL recipient address the stablecoin is delivered to: a 0x… EVM address, or a T… Tron (TRC-20) address for network_id=tron. Checked against the destination allowlist when it is enabled (§4.3).

network_id.description: Destination network for the stablecoin. EVM: polygon, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, base. Tron (TRC-20): tron (USDT only). USDC is not available on tron; USDC is not on base for USDT.

name: wallet_to_stablecoin

claim_address.description: The FINAL recipient address the stablecoin is delivered to.

lock_amount_sats.description: L-BTC locked for the swap (base units).

lockup_txid.description: The broadcast L-BTC lockup transaction id.

post_sync_failed.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) AFTER this money-moving call failed. The money already moved (see the txid); the next balance read reflects it. This is never a failure of the operation itself.

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

title: Convert L-BTC to USDC/USDT
